risks.note: Flagged by the Company as a risk with NEGATIVE financial implications: 'It can have a very large negative impact in terms of loss of business if the CMS is not complied with.' Hazardous chemicals threaten employee and consumer health; various nations restrict or prohibit certain substances and non-compliance can bring legal difficulties and fines, and spills can damage the environment and reputation. Mitigation is a Chemical Management System certified to ZDHC, OEKO-TEX and GOTS and continuously monitored by third-party auditors - which makes certification status a business-continuity dependency, not just a compliance item
risks.risk: Responsible chemical management - dependence on ZDHC / OEKO-TEX / GOTS certification to hold customers

risks.note: Flagged with NEGATIVE financial implications: 'It can have a very large negative impact in terms of loss of business if the safety and quality standards are not met.' Mitigated by process control and quality assurance with 100% inspection of goods before dispatch and stated zero incidents of product recall on safety grounds. Watch item in the same BRSR: customer complaints filed rose to 767 in FY 2025-2026 from 267 in FY 2024-2025, with 13 pending at the close of the year against 20 a year earlier
risks.risk: Product quality and safety - a quality escape is framed as a loss-of-business event

risks.note: Textile production contributes notably to the carbon footprint and the manufacturing process can also release SOx, NOx and other airborne pollutants. Mitigation stated: biomass and other sustainable fuels replacing coal for steam generation, and increasing renewable (solar) energy for scope 1 energy consumption. The Company classifies the financial implication as positive because brands globally favour GHG reduction

Water is pivotal to production; water-intensive operations face operational interruption from scarcity, higher procurement cost and capital investment, and process wastewater must be treated before discharge or the Company incurs regulatory-compliance and mitigation cost. Mitigation stated: an installed wastewater recovery facility (the director's ESG statement adds a Zero Liquid Discharge treatment facility)

Waste arises as a by-product of operations, machinery maintenance and administration; inadequate management could cause air pollution, climate impact, ecosystem consequences and health and safety risk. Mitigation: recycling and re-use of process waste and post-industrial waste, which the Company also treats as a commercial opportunity because customers prefer suppliers offering recycled-content fabrics

Flagged with NEGATIVE financial implications: failure can bring financial penalties and legal consequences, serious incidents can cause severe injuries and liabilities, and safety events cause project delays and downtime that raise cost and reduce profitability. Mitigation: a dedicated safety team, regular training and drills, and monitoring of accident frequency, accident severity rate and accident incident rate by the Head of Safety

Flagged with NEGATIVE financial implications: a high rate of employee turnover could signal low employee satisfaction to potential investors, while prioritising welfare lowers recruitment and integration cost. The only mitigation stated is safety and skill-upgradation training given to all employees during the year

Flagged with NEGATIVE financial implications: violation can lead to legal consequences, reputational damage and loss of investor confidence. Mitigation: anti-discrimination policy, internal code of conduct and stated procedures
